content.short: SundaeSwap is the sweetest decentralized exchange on Cardano and aiming to be the platform for future financial.
content.description: SundaeSwap is a decentralized exchange built for the Cardano blockchain. It allows participants of the blockchain to provide liquidity and create a market for others to exchange their native tokens.In return, swappers pay a small fee and liquidity providers earn a return on their deposit. This and future whitepapers will outline an initial product modeled after the protocol popularized by Uniswap, with several innovative adaptations for the Cardano blockchain. SundaeSwap is a decentralized exchange based on the Cardano Network.
content.meta: Find out about SundaeSwap (SUNDAE) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
